prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent PNG inventory item icon for a top-down academic conference pixel RPG.
Primary request: create one centered, isolated research tool icon.
Subject: a small cream e-reader with a dark teal frame. Its screen shows a mostly blank book page layout: one simple pale-blue geometric illustration block, two small square page markers, and a tiny aged-brass bookmark ribbon symbol at the page corner.
Style/medium: cozy mature pixel art at roughly 64x64 visual resolution, big clean pixel clusters, simple readable shapes, restrained highlights.
Composition/framing: orthographic three-quarter item view; e-reader occupies about 75% of a square canvas with transparent padding.
Color palette: muted teal, walnut brown, cream and aged brass palette matching existing game.
Scene/backdrop: none; no ground, room, pedestal, glow or vignette.
Constraints: genuine alpha transparency. No text, pseudo-writing, letters, numbers, labels, brands, logos or watermark. No horizontal strokes or rows resembling text; page details must be isolated geometric blocks only.
